local_context.value: Wahneta is an unincorporated census-designated place in central Polk County (2020 census: 4,409), ZIP 33880, elevation 131 ft. NWS Tampa Bay: the West Central Florida rainy (thunderstorm) season runs May 25 to October 10; late May through June, hail, damaging winds, waterspouts, heavy rainfall and frequent lightning are common (https://www.weather.gov/tbw/rainyseason). Nearby Lake Gwyn Park was a dry lakebed after a Depression-era drainage canal and has been restored as a wetland that sends clean water to the Peace River (Polk County parks page). No official housing-age figure found.
